Note on Missing Models in OpenCode

Currently, GLM and MiniMax are not the only affected models. Grok and several other OpenAI-category models are also missing. This is an OpenCode application issue.

Until this bug is fixed, test developers can use Pickle as a development aid when working with local, custom, or proxy-based models. Pickle can be used independently to review and adjust their own environment, validate model behavior, and make local fixes where needed.

This suggestion is intended for test and development setups only. It does not fix the OpenCode bug itself, but can help developers keep their local or custom model workflows functional while the issue is being resolved.
Upon review, a OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_DISABLE_COPY_ON_SELECT flag was added in the merged PR #4996. To me, this flag seems entirely adequate to resolve the issue, I'll leave this be.

### Update: Multi-Language Fix (2026-01-25)

Just pushed a fix for browser session refresh that now works regardless of the Claude.ai language setting.

**Problem:** The auto-relogin feature was looking for the "Authorize" button by text, which didn't work when Claude.ai was set to German ("Autorisieren"), French, or other languages.

**Solution:** The button is now found by visual style (background color = primary button) instead of text. This works with any language.

**Changes:**
- Auto-dismiss cookie banners before clicking authorize
- Find authorize button by checking for solid background color (primary button style)
- Skip deny/cancel buttons by checking common patterns across languages

**Context on why this is needed:**

When OpenCode added first-party Codex support (PR #7537), plugins like `opencode-openai-codex-auth` were blocklisted in `plugin/index.ts:53` to prevent duplicates - which makes sense for replacement.

However, there's a valid use case for **extension** rather than replacement: multi-account authentication. Users with multiple ChatGPT subscriptions want to see both options:
- "ChatGPT Pro/Plus" (built-in, single account)
- "ChatGPT Pro/Plus Multi" (external plugin, account rotation)

The current `.find()` returns only the first plugin's methods, so external plugins can never add options to providers with internal plugins. This PR changes it to `.filter()` + `flatMap()` to merge methods while keeping the internal plugin's loader.

This is a minimal, backward-compatible change that enables plugin extensibility without breaking existing behavior.
